purpose: Provenance-backed visual gallery manifest covering all six categories required by plan §2.4 (FL-049; Gates G5 and G9). Large PNG/MP4 media stay in artifact storage (plan §18.5); every entry here is reproducible directly from the committed presets and camera paths.
four_claims_notice: Visual entries establish presentation character only (Visual claim) alongside their paired honest raw G5 views. Scientific and ecological conclusions remain strictly scoped to the cited experiments (experiments/fl048/README.md, experiments/v2-emergence/README.md, experiments/showcase/README.md).
selection_procedure: Each entry pairs one committed, validated preset (seed 42, zero hidden culling or automatic reseeding) with an aesthetic view and an identical-world raw Gate G5 view (unblended dots, zero bloom, linear greyscale field). Camera zoom and intervention commands are declared verbatim and never introduce hidden aesthetic fitness functions inside the world (plan §15.5).
